now you're blue
[D]Put you in jail for something you
didn’t do
[A]I pinned your hands behind your
back, oh
[D]Thought I had reason to at-
tack, but no

[Pre-Chorus]
[A]Fighting with a true love is
boxing with no gloves
[D]Chemistry 'til it blows up, 'til there’s
no us
[E]Why'd I have to break what I
[D]love so much? It's
[E]on your face, and
[D]I'm to blame, I need to say

[A]Hey, it's all

[Bm]head
[D]I'm the one who burned us
[A]down But it's
[E]not what I
[Bm]meant

[A]I don't wanna do, I don’t wanna do this to
[E]you
[Bm]I don’t wanna lose, I don't wanna lose this with
[D]you I need to say,
[A]hey, it’s all
[E]me, just don't
[Bm]go
[D]Meet me in the afterglow

[A]It's so excruciating to
see you low
[D]Just wanna lift you up and not
let you go

light below
[D]Tells me this love is worth the
fight, oh

punished you with silence
